narrative.overview: Zoid 25 translates Villa Kujoyama's architectural restraint into a local-first macOS AI operating system: severe black rules, white editorial fields, one committed cobalt structural surface, mono-forward hierarchy, and sparse yellow emphasis.
keyCharacteristics: Stark black-and-white editorial shell with cobalt-blue architecture.
Mono-forward type for navigation, labels, command surfaces, and operational titles.
Squared tactile controls with 1px black strokes and zero radius.
Status vocabulary uses both color and text.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is architecture and state, not decoration.

rules.name: The Status Text Rule
rules.body: Color dots and badges must always be paired with text labels.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Structure Rule
rules.body: Use mono for navigation, commands, status labels, IDs, counters, tabs, and row titles.

rules.name: The Rule-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Add a border before adding a shadow.

dos: Do use black 1px rules and squared edges as the default visual grammar.
Do reserve cobalt blue for architecture, selection, primary action, and verified/progress surfaces.
Do mark native, preview, blocked, ready, verified, paused, and failed states with explicit text.
donts: Don't make Zoid feel like a generic SaaS dashboard card grid.
Don't use AI-chat novelty surfaces, decorative gradients, fake metrics, or simulated records presented as truth.
Don't over-round controls into bubble UI.
Don't hide review gates, backend availability, data source, bridge requirements, or verification state.
